description: Twelve default real street lights, editable count and player activation distance, independent lamp illumination reach.
notes: Download all four files as raw bytes from baseUrl + source; replace their exact target paths. Preserve all unlisted files, importer, aliases, host wrapper, dependencies, server and saved artwork.
Live Settings: NEARBY REAL LIGHTS defaults to 12 (0–32); LIGHTS ON WITHIN (m) defaults to 60 (2–120). Nearest eligible lamps receive real light up to the selected count; player light is separate.
LAMP REACH controls illumination radius independently of player activation distance. Count and range apply live and persist.
Existing Map 2 adopts twelve lights once; sky, distance and other preferences remain preserved. Later user choices persist.
Pooled real lights do not cast shadows. No new assets, geometry or paint addresses.
